APPROVE

The original `Lex` logic carries over exactly, including the `next is '/' or '*'` check, the verbatim, escape and newline handling, the raw-literal fence, and the clamping and termination, and every extracted helper and the slimmed-down `Lex` should now fall well under a complexity of 15. I reviewed the diff only and did not build or run the tests, so the warnings-as-errors build is unconfirmed. Nothing in the diff looks likely to produce a warning.
